keywords.indexterm: power trunk operating the power trunk

li.p: Power trunk open/close button inside the vehicle
Power trunk open/close button on the smart key
Power trunk open/close button outside the vehicle
Power trunk close button inside the power trunk
When the trunk is closed, press the power trunk open/close button inside the vehicle (1) for 1 second. The power trunk opens with a warning sound.
When the trunk is closed, press the power trunk open/close button on the smart key (2) for 1 second. The power trunk opens with a warning sound.
When the trunk is closed, press the power trunk open/close button outside the vehicle (3) to open the trunk.
Press the power trunk close button inside the power trunk (4). The trunk opens or closes automatically.
When the trunk is closed, press the power trunk open/close button inside the vehicle (1) for 1 second. The power trunk will open with a warning sound.
While the trunk is opening, press the button to stop trunk operation.

When the power trunk is opened, press and hold the power trunk open/close button to close the trunk. If you release the button while the trunk is closing, power trunk operation will stop with a warning sound for 5 seconds.
When the trunk is closed, press the power trunk open/close button on the smart key (2) for 1 second. The power trunk opens with a warning sound.
While the trunk is opening, press the button to stop trunk operation.

When the power trunk is opened, press and hold the power trunk open/close button to close the trunk. If you release the button while the trunk is closing, power trunk operation will stop with a warning sound for 5 seconds.
If the smart key is not within operation range (approximately 10 m) from the vehicle, trunk operation will stop with a warning sound for 5 seconds.
When the trunk is closed, press the power trunk open/close button outside the vehicle (3) to open the trunk.
If the vehicle is locked, press the power trunk open/close button with the smart key in your possession.
While the trunk is opening, press the button to stop power trunk operation.
Press the power trunk close button inside the power trunk (4). The trunk closes automatically.
While the trunk is closing, press the button to stop power trunk operation
When the gear is in P (Park) with the vehicle in POWER ON or DRIVE READY position
When the vehicle is in OFF position
The vehicle speed is above 3 km/h (1.8 mph)
